purpose: Freeze the exact Banner Stage 2 entry inputs and correction-consumption rules before canonical bannerDefinition grouping or any Stage 2 consumer generation.

effectiveSourceView.reason: Do not duplicate 94 already-frozen occurrence rows when Stage 2-0 changes only one source relation. Reuse the Stage 1 schedule and store the minimal verified overlay.
effectiveSourceView.effectiveValueSource: data/checkpoints/banner-stage1-4-relation-corrections.v1.json when a verified correction exists; otherwise the recorded sourceRecordKey
effectiveSourceView.manualNullPolicy: A null sourceRecordKey remains null unless an explicit approved correction or mapping exists; Stage 2-0 does not synthesize CardPool identity.
effectiveSourceView.consumerRule: Stage 2-1 and all later canonical grouping/relation consumers must resolve source identity through this effective view instead of reading sourceRecordKey from the schedule directly.

frozenBoundaries: Occurrence identity remains distinct from CardPool source identity and future canonical bannerDefinition identity.
recordKey, sourceRecordKey, bannerCode and displayImageFile are not canonical bannerDefinition IDs.
Source-null manual occurrences are valid and must not receive synthetic CardPool, Hero or recurrence relations in Stage 2-0.
Hero relations remain exact-ID only and PICKUP_HERO remains distinct from WISH_CANDIDATE_HERO.
CP_RELATED remains non-exclusive context; canonical Event ID remains REVIEW until explicitly proven.
krDisplayDate remains day-precision occurrence display date; no endDate, duration, timezone or exact timestamp is invented.
Asset references remain display/provenance references and are not canonical identity evidence.
stage2_0ProhibitedWork: No bannerDefinition grouping beyond proving the effective input contract.
No final canonical bannerDefinition or bannerOccurrence ID assignment.
No 94-row duplicate materialization when a correction overlay is sufficient.
No asset hashing, perceptual duplicate analysis or candidate replacement work.
No name-based Hero or Event joins.

nextStartPoint.task: Canonical bannerDefinition/bannerOccurrence identity and grouping policy
